statement: The full profinite GT_0 is the inverse limit of isolated finite shadows; the image of its elements of order dividing d is the intersection of the images of order-dividing-d elements at every isolated refinement. Exact order is detected at one level. Two elements are conjugate precisely when all their finite shadow coordinates are conjugate.
depends_on: A-DGShadows, Proposition 3.14, Proposition 5.1, Theorem 5.2 and Proposition 5.5
manuscript_passages: Part D(b) of the task: full GT_0 torsion
notes: Unconditional finite-intersection proof retaining the fixed base shadow, order equation, and compatibility at every deeper level; no surjectivity of general shadow maps assumed. D.32 subsequently excludes odd torsion and all finite subgroups of order greater than two in full GT_0. The criterion remains exact and applies to the unresolved involution-conjugacy problem of D.35.

statement: Executed nonnilpotent dihedral GT_0 shadow tests eliminate order-three shadows at levels 6→18, 18→54 and 54→162, while all 14 order-three shadows at level 14 survive to level 98. The full dyadic shadow quotient has exactly one conjugacy class of nontrivial finite subgroups, all cyclic of order two. The dihedral family is not cofinal, as witnessed by the explicit perfect A_5 quotient.
where_proved: work/part_a/gt_shadow.tex, D.24; code/part_a/gt_shadow_refinement.py; corresponding JSON and CSV outputs
depends_on: A-BDHPShadows, Theorem 4.3, Proposition 4.5, Theorem 5.7 and Proposition 5.8
manuscript_passages: Part D(b) of the task: finite-quotient torsion program
notes: Direct exhaustive cycle and Cayley-edge checks for n=4,6,8,12,14, plus all-element bounded-order refinement counts through n=162. D.32 excludes full GT_0 odd torsion; together with D.23 this proves that a common isolated refinement excludes all fourteen surviving level-14 order-three shadows. That refinement was not computed. D.34 proves every nontrivial involution has global multiplier minus one; its conjugacy remains the exact D.35 equation, with D.44 first symmetry proved.
